notes.title: THERE'S SOMETHING WRONG WITH... DEMO RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the launch of the demo for [b]"There’s Something Wrong with…"[/b], scheduled to release on [b]June 7th 2024[/b]. 

This new horror adventure demo will be available at the upcoming Steam [b]NEXT FEST[/b] in June.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/f7ecaa76fcb1b950e8eb37324670662aebe14c2a.png[/img]


[b]"There’s Something Wrong with…"[/b] is a first-person horror experience set in enigmatic tunnels. As players navigate through dark passages, they will discover notes, interactive objects, unusual human remains and monstrous entity. During Steam’s Next Fest, players will have the opportunity to explore these environments, experience the gameplay mechanics, and encounter formidable foe...

So, stay tuned for more updates and prepare yourself for a creepy adventure. Mark your calendars for [b]June 7th 2024[/b] and get ready to dive into the world of [b]"There’s Something Wrong with…"[/b] and during Steam’s [b]NEXT FEST[/b] this June.


[h1][b]DEMO FEATURES[/b][/h1]

        [h3][b]MYSTERIOUS TUNNELS[/b][/h3]
What could you find at the end of this tunnel? Because these tunnels are strange. Not always dark, but always concealing a secret or two. And the entity roaming through those mysterious halls... it is not just roaming... IT IS hunting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/797631b29cb9bdd372422912ea827e63c4c38774.png[/img]

       [h3][b]REPLICATOR[/b][/h3]
The game does not feature a traditional inventory system. Instead, players utilize a special tool known as the Replicator. With the Replicator, players can duplicate specific elements of the environment and seamlessly paste them onto other unique areas. Well, as long as there is a source of a bright light covering an object(s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/a2be8073379ed1289dccbf6952bcffc335c1fcef.png[/img]

       [h3][b]HIDE AND SEEK[/b][/h3]
The Monster, lurking in the shadows of mysterious tunnels, cannot be defeated, or even wounded. Direct confrontation is impossible, so players must rely solely on hiding tactics to survive.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/0012c3388d7b0213ef680a7975c6a2e619a5d0c8.png[/img]

       [h3][b]CHECKPOINT[/b][/h3]
The game demo features a checkpoint system, so if a player is discovered and devoured by an enemy, they will not have to start the entire game from the beginning.


So, who dares to find out what’s at the end of THIS TUNNEL?

Big thanks and all the best from the Gamenastica Studios team!
